fullDescription:
Achieve a beautiful, painterly gouache look in your digital art with this set of 16 Gouache Floral Procreate Brushes! Designed to mimic the opaque, matte texture of traditional gouache paint, these brushes are perfect for creating stunning floral illustrations, botanical art, landscapes, and charming backgrounds.

What’s Included:

✔✨16 Unique Procreate Brushes in one `.brushset` file.

A variety of brush shapes optimized for painting leaves, petals, grass, tree foliage, and textures.
Brushes range from stamps for building up foliage (e.g., for trees and bushes) to liners and detail brushes for stems and veins.
Includes texture brushes to create authentic-looking gouache backgrounds (like the sky in the preview).

❤Perfect For:

Botanical Illustration: Easily paint realistic or stylized flowers, plants, and greenery.
Landscape Painting: Create textured grass, trees, bushes, and skies with a traditional feel.
Children’s Book Illustration: Achieve a soft, painterly style perfect for storybooks.
Greeting Cards & Stationery: Design lovely floral elements for cards and invitations.
Surface Pattern Design: Create hand-painted floral motifs for patterns.

❤Features:

Easy to install and use.
Pressure-sensitive for expressive strokes.
Designed to layer beautifully, creating depth and texture just like real gouache.
Optimized for Procreate on iPad with Apple Pencil.
What you will receive:

1 `.brushset` file containing all 16 brushes.

❤How to Install:

Download the ZIP file to your iPad.
Unzip the file (using the Files app or an unzip app).
Tap on the `.brushset` file to automatically import it into Procreate.
PLEASE NOTE: These brushes are designed exclusively for the Procreate App on the iPad. They will not work in Photoshop or any other software. Apple Pencil required for pressure sensitivity features.

Bring the charm of traditional gouache painting to your digital canvas with this essential floral brush set!
